JAYA MANOJ UPADHYAY Dombivli, India | 9004265544 |jayaupadhyayjmu98@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Detail-oriented Analyst with hands-on experience in trading and investment operations, market operations, instrument lifecycle management, execution quality analysis, and regulatory compliance. Proven ability to handle complex escalations, coordinate with exchanges and data vendors, and ensure best execution across equities, funds, bonds, and crypto assets. Highly analytical, process-driven, and adept at high-volume operational environments.

SKILLS

Trading & Investment Operations

Instrument Lifecycle Management

Market Operations

Best Execution Analysis

Market Data Validation

Regulatory Compliance

L3 Escalation Handling

Crypto Compliance

MS Word

Advance Excel

PowerPoint

Internet Application s

EXPERIENCE

Sterling Outsourcing Pvt. Ltd. – Analyst, Trade Republic Bank (December 2024 – Aug 2026)

Managed instrument onboarding, lifecycle and trading support across European markets. • Handled global trade settlement, market operations and daily trade execution activities. • Validated market/reference data and performed reconciliation and root-cause analysis. • Created and maintained client/entity master records and hierarchical relationships in accordance with established operational and data- governance procedures.

Reviewed and validated parent-child relationships, legal entity information, account relationships, and client static data to ensure accurate downstream processing.

Performed regular validation of client and account attributes and investigated discrepancies between client master data, trading systems, and reference-data sources.

Created, reviewed, validated, and maintained Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI) for client accounts in accordance with established operational controls.

Validated SSI details including settlement account, custodian, market, currency, and settlement-related information prior to system maintenance • Validated SSI details during callback, including settlement account, custodian, market, currency, and other settlement-related information, ensuring accuracy before system maintenance.

Reviewed 100–150 trade cases daily for best execution and timely resolution. • Managed L3 escalations, Block Order Checks and open market order monitoring. • Coordinated with exchanges and data vendors including Fundinfo and LSEG. • Supported trading restrictions, regulatory compliance and crypto compliance monitoring. • Utilized Advanced Excel to validate, analyze, reconcile, and maintain large volumes of client, account, trade, and reference data. • Resolved client queries related to trades, orders and operational activities. • Platforms: Exgone, CATS, LSX. Zepto Commodum Groceries Pvt. Ltd. – Customer Service Executive (May 2024 – Oct 2024)

Handled customer queries, order support, and issue resolution in a fast-paced service environment. • Maintained accurate communication and coordinated with internal teams to ensure timely service delivery. 1point1 Solutions (Medical Process) – Customer Service Executive (Jan 2022 – Aug 2022)

Managed customer communication and resolved process-related queries with a focus on accuracy and service quality. • Supported day-to-day operations and maintained service standards in a medical process environment.

EDUCATION

Graduation: Satyagrah College, Mumbai University HSC: Tilak College (Vashi), Mumbai University SSC: R.M.V (Airoli), Maharashtra Board

PERSONAL STRENGTHS

Dedicated and hardworking professional with strong self-confidence, patience, adaptability, and a high level of commitment to quality and accuracy.
